    static double[] TIMES;
    static Set<String> originalNumerical;
    static TreeMap<String,String> before;
    static Set<String> newTags=new TreeSet<String>();
    static BufferedWriter events;
    static List<String[]> status=new ArrayList<String[]>();
    static String[] GUARD_UNITS={"s","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","1","1","1"};
    static String hashInput() throws Exception {
        MessageDigest digest=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
        try(InputStream in=Files.newInputStream(Paths.get(INPUT))) {
            byte[] b=new byte[1048576];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1) digest.update(b,0,n);
        }
        return hex(digest.digest());
    }
    static String hex(byte[] data) {StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder();for(byte b:data)s.append(String.format("%02x",b&255));return s.toString();}
    static String inputCheck(String phase) throws Exception {
        String h=hashInput(); event("input_sha_"+phase,h);
        if(!h.equals(EXPECTED)||Files.size(Paths.get(INPUT))!=1266539803L)throw new IllegalStateException("Input identity mismatch");
        return h;
    }
    static String vectorDigest(double[] data) throws Exception {
        MessageDigest md=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
        for(double v:data) {if(!Double.isFinite(v))throw new IllegalStateException("Nonfinite U");
            long bits=Double.doubleToLongBits(v);for(int k=7;k>=0;k--)md.update((byte)(bits>>>(8*k)));}
        return hex(md.digest());
    }
    static BufferedWriter writer(String name) throws Exception {
        if(!name.matches("[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+"))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsafe output name");
        return Files.newBufferedWriter(OUT.resolve(name),StandardCharsets.UTF_8,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
    }
    static void row(BufferedWriter w,String[] cells) throws IOException {
        for(int i=0;i<cells.length;i++){if(i>0)w.write(',');w.write('"');w.write(cells[i]==null?"":cells[i].replace("\"","\"\""));w.write('"');}w.write('\n');
    }
    static void event(String kind,String value) throws Exception {
        if(events==null){System.out.println("APREP_PRELOG="+kind+"|"+value);return;}
        row(events,new String[]{kind,value});events.flush();
    }
    static void table(String file,String[][] rows) throws Exception {
        try(BufferedWriter w=writer(file)){if(rows!=null)for(String[] r:rows){if(r==null)throw new IOException("Null info row");row(w,r);}}
        event("file_closed",file);
    }
    static void numericTable(String file,String[] headers,double[][] data) throws Exception {
        if(data.length!=headers.length)throw new IllegalStateException("Header shape "+file);
        for(double[] v:data)if(v.length!=TIMES.length)throw new IllegalStateException("Time shape "+file);
        try(BufferedWriter w=writer(file)){row(w,headers);
            for(int i=0;i<TIMES.length;i++){if(data[0][i]!=TIMES[i])throw new IllegalStateException("Exact time mismatch "+file);
                String[] cells=new String[headers.length];for(int e=0;e<headers.length;e++){
                    if(!Double.isFinite(data[e][i]))throw new IllegalStateException("Nonfinite "+file);cells[e]=Double.toString(data[e][i]);}row(w,cells);}}
        event("file_closed",file);
    }
    static Exception cleanupFailure=null;
    static void rememberCleanup(Exception e) {
        if(cleanupFailure==null)cleanupFailure=e;
        else if(cleanupFailure!=e)cleanupFailure.addSuppressed(e);
    }
    static void cleanupRecord(String name,String result,String detail) {
        try {status.add(new String[]{name,result,detail});}
        catch(Exception recordError) {rememberCleanup(recordError);}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        // Preferences first. No output/authorization-token file I/O can preempt the input hash gate.
        ModelUtil.loadPreferences();
        if(!"on".equals(ModelUtil.getPreference("security.external.enable")))throw new IllegalStateException("Enforce security must remain on");
        String verifiedBefore=inputCheck("before");
        if(!Files.isDirectory(OUT)||Files.exists(OUT.resolve("events.csv")))throw new IllegalStateException("Fresh output directory required");
        // Launcher creates this receipt only after B approval and one-time reservation.
        if(!Files.isRegularFile(RUN.resolve("batch_authorized.json")))throw new IllegalStateException("B authorization receipt absent");
        events=writer("events.csv"); row(events,new String[]{"kind","value"});
        event("input_sha_before",verifiedBefore);
        Model model=null; boolean loaded=false; Exception primary=null;
        try {
            String[] keys={"security.external.enable","security.external.filepermission","security.comsol.allowapplications","security.comsol.allowbatch","security.comsol.allowexternallibraries","security.comsol.allowexternalmatlab","security.comsol.allowexternalprocess","security.comsol.allowforms","security.comsol.allowmethods","security.external.modelmanagerdatabasepermission","security.external.netpermission","security.external.propertypermission","security.external.reflectpermission","security.external.runtimepermission","security.external.securitypermission","security.external.socketpermission"};
            String[][] pv=new String[keys.length+1][2];pv[0]=new String[]{"key","value"};
            for(int i=0;i<keys.length;i++)pv[i+1]=new String[]{keys[i],ModelUtil.getPreference(keys[i])};
            table("effective_preferences.csv",pv);
            if(!"on".equals(pv[1][1]))throw new IllegalStateException("Enforce security must remain on");
            // Expected token is captured from approved UI observation, never guessed in source.
            String permission=Files.readAllLines(RUN.resolve("permission_token.txt"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8).get(0);
            if(!permission.equals(pv[2][1])||"limited".equals(permission))throw new IllegalStateException("Dedicated preference readback mismatch");
            model=ModelUtil.loadCopy("RecoveryCopy",INPUT); loaded=true; event("loaded","RecoveryCopy");
            final Model m=model;
            String sol=m.result().dataset("daudit").getString("solution");
            if(!"sol1".equals(sol)||!"mesh1".equals(m.sol(sol).getMesh("geom1")))throw new IllegalStateException("Stored solution/mesh binding");
            TIMES=m.sol(sol).getPVals();
            if(!Arrays.equals(TIMES,EXPECTED_TIMES))throw new IllegalStateException("Stored times differ from preserved Desktop/baseline contract");
            numericTable("recovery_native_times.csv",new String[]{"time_s"},new double[][]{TIMES});
            originalNumerical=new TreeSet<String>(Arrays.asList(m.result().numerical().tags()));
            before=snapshot(m); writeMap("before_properties.csv",before);
            m.save(OUT.resolve("before_history.java").toString(),"java");
            uSnapshot(m,"before_U.csv");
            runtimeSettings(m,sol,"t1");
            required(m,sol);
            event("required_outputs","CLOSED");status.add(new String[]{"numeric_exports","CLOSED","offline checks still required"});
        } catch(Exception e){primary=e;cleanupRecord("primary","FAILED",e.toString());}
        finally {
            final Model m=model;
            String cleanupName="after_U";
            try {if(!loaded||TIMES==null)throw new IllegalStateException("No loaded/before time contract");uSnapshot(m,"after_U.csv");cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"PASS","");}
            catch(Exception e){rememberCleanup(e);cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"INCOMPLETE",e.toString());}
            cleanupName="after_properties";
            try {if(!loaded)throw new IllegalStateException("load not reached");TreeMap<String,String> after=snapshot(m);writeMap("after_properties.csv",after);
                if(before==null||!before.equals(after))throw new IllegalStateException("Preserved property set/value changed");cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"PASS","");}
            catch(Exception e){rememberCleanup(e);cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"INCOMPLETE",e.toString());}
            cleanupName="after_history";
            try {if(!loaded)throw new IllegalStateException("load not reached");m.save(OUT.resolve("after_history.java").toString(),"java");cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"PASS","");}
            catch(Exception e){rememberCleanup(e);cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"INCOMPLETE",e.toString());}
            cleanupName="input_after";
            try {inputCheck("after");cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"PASS","");}
            catch(Exception e){rememberCleanup(e);cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"INCOMPLETE",e.toString());}
            cleanupName="release_copy";
            try {if(!loaded)throw new IllegalStateException("load not reached");ModelUtil.remove("RecoveryCopy");cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"PASS","");}
            catch(Exception e){rememberCleanup(e);cleanupRecord(cleanupName,"INCOMPLETE",e.toString());}
            // Output/close errors never replace the original evaluation exception or skip release.
            try {List<String[]> r=new ArrayList<String[]>();r.add(new String[]{"check","status","detail"});r.addAll(status);table("java_status.csv",r.toArray(new String[0][]));}
            catch(Exception e){rememberCleanup(e);}
            try {if(events!=null)events.close();}
            catch(Exception e){rememberCleanup(e);}
        }
        if(primary!=null){if(cleanupFailure!=null&&cleanupFailure!=primary)primary.addSuppressed(cleanupFailure);throw primary;}
        if(cleanupFailure!=null)throw cleanupFailure;
        for(String[] s:status)if("INCOMPLETE".equals(s[1]))throw new IllegalStateException("Preservation incomplete: "+s[0]);
    }
    static void ensureNew(Model m,String tag) {
        if(!tag.startsWith(PREFIX)||Arrays.asList(m.result().numerical().tags()).contains(tag))throw new IllegalStateException("Existing/unapproved tag "+tag);
        newTags.add(tag);
    }
    static double[][] evaluate(Model m,String tag,String type,String[] expr,String[] units,int[] entities) throws Exception {
        tag=PREFIX+tag;ensureNew(m,tag);m.result().numerical().create(tag,type);
        m.result().numerical(tag).set("data","daudit");
        if(entities!=null){if(!type.equals("EvalPoint"))m.result().numerical(tag).selection().geom("geom1",1);m.result().numerical(tag).selection().set(entities);}
        m.result().numerical(tag).set("expr",expr);if(units!=null)m.result().numerical(tag).set("unit",units);
        m.result().numerical(tag).set("innerinput","all");
        if(!"daudit".equals(m.result().numerical(tag).getString("data"))||!"all".equals(m.result().numerical(tag).getString("innerinput")))throw new IllegalStateException("Numerical binding readback "+tag);
        if(!Arrays.equals(expr,m.result().numerical(tag).getStringArray("expr")))throw new IllegalStateException("Numerical expression readback "+tag);
        validateNumerical(m,tag,units!=null);
        event("evaluate",tag);double[][] values=m.result().numerical(tag).getReal();
        if(values.length!=expr.length)throw new IllegalStateException("Expression shape "+tag);
        for(double[] v:values){if(v.length!=TIMES.length)throw new IllegalStateException("Time shape "+tag);for(double x:v)if(!Double.isFinite(x))throw new IllegalStateException("Nonfinite "+tag);}
        if(!Arrays.equals(values[0],TIMES))throw new IllegalStateException("Exact time mismatch "+tag);
        validateNumerical(m,tag,true);
        dumpNew(m,tag);return values;
    }
    static void dumpNew(Model m,String tag) throws Exception {
        dumpNew(m,tag,tag.equals(PREFIX+"recoveryGuard")?"inferred":"explicit",tag+"_properties.csv");
    }
    static void dumpNew(Model m,String tag,String stage,String file) throws Exception {
        TreeMap<String,String> p=new TreeMap<String,String>();props(m.result().numerical(tag),"numerical/"+tag,p);
        p.put("numerical/"+tag+"/@has_selection",Boolean.toString(m.result().numerical(tag).hasSelection()));
        p.put("numerical/"+tag+"/@unit_stage",stage);writeMap(file,p);
    }
    static void validateNumerical(Model m,String tag,boolean checkUnits) {
        NumericalFeature f=m.result().numerical(tag);
        String type; String[] expr,units; int[] selection=null; int dim=-1;
        switch(tag) {
        case "aprep_recoveryGuard":type="EvalGlobal";expr=new String[]{"t","comp1.minguardall(comp1.cl)","comp1.minguard1(comp1.cl)","comp1.minguard2(comp1.cl)","comp1.minguard3(comp1.cl)","ce_stop_threshold","comp1.minguardall(comp1.cl)<=ce_stop_threshold","(comp1.minsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)<0)||(comp1.maxsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)>0.98)||(comp1.minsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)<0.2228930343076256)||(comp1.maxsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)>0.983245033354389)","(comp1.minsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)<=0)||(comp1.maxsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)>=1)||(comp1.minsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)<=0)||(comp1.maxsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)>=1)"};units=new String[]{"s","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","1","1","1"};break;
        case "aprep_nglobal":type="EvalGlobal";expr=new String[]{"t","comp1.intd1(comp1.liion.epss*comp1.liion.cs_average)","comp1.intd3(comp1.liion.epss*comp1.liion.cs_average)","comp1.intd1(comp1.liion.epsl*comp1.cl)+comp1.intd2(comp1.liion.epsl*comp1.cl)+comp1.intd3(comp1.liion.epsl*comp1.cl)","comp1.intd1(comp1.liion.cs_average)/(L_el*cs_Gr_max)","comp1.intd3(comp1.liion.cs_average)/(L_pos*cs_NCM_max)","comp1.minsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)","comp1.maxsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)","comp1.minsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)","comp1.maxsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)","(comp1.minsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)<0)||(comp1.maxsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)>0.98)||(comp1.minsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)<0.2228930343076256)||(comp1.maxsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)>0.983245033354389)","comp1.intd1(comp1.liion.ivtot)","comp1.intd3(comp1.liion.ivtot)","-comp1.intd2(comp1.liion.Isx)/L_sep"};units=new String[]{"s","mol/m^2","mol/m^2","mol/m^2","1","1","1","1","1","1","1","A/m^2","A/m^2","A/m^2"};break;
        case "aprep_point1":type="EvalPoint";expr=new String[]{"t","phis","phil","liion.Eeq_per1","liion.eta_per1","liion.etamid_per1","liion.socloc_surface","liion.cs_average/liion.csmax","liion.cs_surface","liion.pce1.per1.minput_concentration","liion.csmax","mat35.def.Eeq(liion.socloc_surface)+mat35.def.dEeqdT(liion.socloc_surface)*(T_init-298[K])","liion.Isx"};units=new String[]{"s","V","V","V","V","V","1","1","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","V","A/m^2"};selection=new int[]{1};dim=0;break;
        case "aprep_point4":type="EvalPoint";expr=new String[]{"t","phis","phil","liion.Eeq_per1","liion.eta_per1","liion.etamid_per1","liion.socloc_surface","liion.cs_average/liion.csmax","liion.cs_surface","liion.pce2.per1.minput_concentration","liion.csmax","mat54.def.Eeq(liion.socloc_surface)+mat54.def.dEeqdT(liion.socloc_surface)*(T_init-298[K])","liion.Isx"};units=new String[]{"s","V","V","V","V","V","1","1","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","V","A/m^2"};selection=new int[]{4};dim=0;break;
        case "aprep_MinLinece":type="MinLine";expr=new String[]{"t","cl"};units=new String[]{"s","mol/m^3"};selection=new int[]{1,2,3};dim=1;break;
        case "aprep_MaxLinece":type="MaxLine";expr=new String[]{"t","cl"};units=new String[]{"s","mol/m^3"};selection=new int[]{1,2,3};dim=1;break;
        case "aprep_profiletimes":type="EvalGlobal";expr=new String[]{"t"};units=new String[]{"s"};break;
        case "aprep_profileN":type="Interp";expr=new String[]{"t","x","liion.socloc_surface","liion.cs_average/liion.csmax","liion.Eeq_per1","liion.etamid_per1","phil","dom"};units=new String[]{"s","m","1","1","V","V","V","1"};selection=new int[]{1};dim=1;break;
        case "aprep_profileP":type="Interp";expr=new String[]{"t","x","liion.socloc_surface","liion.cs_average/liion.csmax","liion.Eeq_per1","liion.etamid_per1","phil","dom"};units=new String[]{"s","m","1","1","V","V","V","1"};selection=new int[]{3};dim=1;break;
        default:throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown numerical contract "+tag);
        }
        if(!type.equals(f.getType())||!"daudit".equals(f.getString("data"))||!"all".equals(f.getString("innerinput")))throw new IllegalStateException("Numerical type/data/time "+tag);
        if(!Arrays.equals(expr,f.getStringArray("expr")))throw new IllegalStateException("Numerical expr "+tag);
        if(checkUnits&&!Arrays.equals(units,f.getStringArray("unit")))throw new IllegalStateException("Numerical unit "+tag);
        if(selection==null) {if(f.hasSelection())throw new IllegalStateException("Unexpected global selection "+tag);}
        else if(!f.hasSelection()||f.selection().dim()!=dim||!Arrays.equals(selection,f.selection().entities(dim)))throw new IllegalStateException("Numerical selection "+tag);
    }
    static void validateInterp(Model m,String tag,double[] coordinates,int domain) {
        NumericalFeature f=m.result().numerical(tag);
        if(!"daudit".equals(f.getString("data"))||!"all".equals(f.getString("innerinput"))||!"off".equals(f.getString("recover"))||!"off".equals(f.getString("timeinterp"))||!"on".equals(f.getString("coorderr"))||f.getDouble("ext")!=0)throw new IllegalStateException("Interp readback modes");
        if(f.selection().dim()!=1||!Arrays.equals(f.selection().entities(1),new int[]{domain})||!Arrays.deepEquals(f.getDoubleMatrix("coord"),new double[][]{coordinates}))throw new IllegalStateException("Interp coordinate/domain readback");
    }
    static void required(Model m,String sol) throws Exception {
        String[] cond=m.sol(sol).feature("t1").feature("stguard").getStringArray("stopcondarr");
        if(cond.length!=3 || !cond[2].equals("comp1.minguardall(comp1.cl)<=ce_stop_threshold"))throw new IllegalStateException("Guard mismatch");
        String guard=cond[0],concentrationGuard=cond[1];
        String nmin="comp1.minsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)",nmax="comp1.maxsurf1(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)";
        String pmin="comp1.minsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)",pmax="comp1.maxsurf3(comp1.liion.socloc_surface)";
        String[] expr={"t","comp1.minguardall(comp1.cl)","comp1.minguard1(comp1.cl)","comp1.minguard2(comp1.cl)","comp1.minguard3(comp1.cl)","ce_stop_threshold",cond[2],cond[0],cond[1]};
        String[] headers={"time_s","ce_min_all_mol_m3","ce_min_d1_mol_m3","ce_min_d2_mol_m3","ce_min_d3_mol_m3","threshold_mol_m3","electrolyte_guard","ocp_guard","surface_guard"};
        double[][] gv=evaluate(m,"recoveryGuard","EvalGlobal",expr,null,null);
        String[] inferredGuardUnits=m.result().numerical(PREFIX+"recoveryGuard").getStringArray("unit");
        if(!Arrays.equals(inferredGuardUnits,GUARD_UNITS))throw new IllegalStateException("Inferred guard units");
        System.out.println("RECOVERY_GUARD_INFERRED_UNITS="+Arrays.toString(m.result().numerical(PREFIX+"recoveryGuard").getStringArray("unit")));
        numericTable("electrolyte_guard_inferred.csv",headers,gv);
        m.result().numerical(PREFIX+"recoveryGuard").set("unit",new String[]{"s","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","1","1","1"});
        validateNumerical(m,PREFIX+"recoveryGuard",true);
        event("evaluate",PREFIX+"recoveryGuard_explicit_units");
        numericTable("electrolyte_guard.csv",headers,m.result().numerical(PREFIX+"recoveryGuard").getReal());
        System.out.println("RECOVERY_GUARD_EXPLICIT_UNITS="+Arrays.toString(m.result().numerical(PREFIX+"recoveryGuard").getStringArray("unit")));
        validateNumerical(m,PREFIX+"recoveryGuard",true);
        dumpNew(m,PREFIX+"recoveryGuard","explicit",PREFIX+"recoveryGuard_explicit_properties.csv");
        String[] globalExpr={"t","comp1.intd1(comp1.liion.epss*comp1.liion.cs_average)","comp1.intd3(comp1.liion.epss*comp1.liion.cs_average)",
            "comp1.intd1(comp1.liion.epsl*comp1.cl)+comp1.intd2(comp1.liion.epsl*comp1.cl)+comp1.intd3(comp1.liion.epsl*comp1.cl)",
            "comp1.intd1(comp1.liion.cs_average)/(L_el*cs_Gr_max)","comp1.intd3(comp1.liion.cs_average)/(L_pos*cs_NCM_max)",
            nmin,nmax,pmin,pmax,guard,"comp1.intd1(comp1.liion.ivtot)","comp1.intd3(comp1.liion.ivtot)","-comp1.intd2(comp1.liion.Isx)/L_sep"};
        numericTable("preflight_global.csv",new String[]{"time_s","Li_N_mol_m2","Li_P_mol_m2","Li_electrolyte_mol_m2","xavg_N","xavg_P","xsurf_N_min","xsurf_N_max","xsurf_P_min","xsurf_P_max","ocp_guard","reaction_N_A_m2","reaction_P_A_m2","leak_leftward_A_m2"},
            evaluate(m,"nglobal","EvalGlobal",globalExpr,new String[]{"s","mol/m^2","mol/m^2","mol/m^2","1","1","1","1","1","1","1","A/m^2","A/m^2","A/m^2"},null));
        for(int b:new int[]{1,4}) {
            String mat=b==1?"mat35":"mat54",pce=b==1?"pce1":"pce2";
            String fn=mat+".def.Eeq(liion.socloc_surface)+"+mat+".def.dEeqdT(liion.socloc_surface)*(T_init-298[K])";
            numericTable("preflight_boundary"+b+".csv",new String[]{"time_s","phis_V","phil_V","Eeq_V","eta_V","etamid_V","x_surface","x_particle_average","cs_surface_mol_m3","reaction_input_mol_m3","csmax_mol_m3","direct_Eeq_surface_V","Isx_A_m2"},
                evaluate(m,"point"+b,"EvalPoint",new String[]{"t","phis","phil","liion.Eeq_per1","liion.eta_per1","liion.etamid_per1","liion.socloc_surface","liion.cs_average/liion.csmax","liion.cs_surface","liion."+pce+".per1.minput_concentration","liion.csmax",fn,"liion.Isx"},
                new String[]{"s","V","V","V","V","V","1","1","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","mol/m^3","V","A/m^2"},new int[]{b}));
        }
        for(String type:new String[]{"MinLine","MaxLine"}) numericTable("preflight_"+type+"_ce.csv",new String[]{"time_s","ce_mol_m3"},evaluate(m,type+"ce",type,new String[]{"t","cl"},new String[]{"s","mol/m^3"},new int[]{1,2,3}));

        audit(m.component("comp1").physics("liion").feature("pce1").feature("per1"),"pce1_per1");
        audit(m.component("comp1").physics("liion").feature("pce2").feature("per1"),"pce2_per1");
        spatialProfiles(m);

        String[] actual=m.result().numerical(PREFIX+"recoveryGuard").getStringArray("unit");
        if(!Arrays.equals(actual,GUARD_UNITS))throw new IllegalStateException("Explicit guard units");
        table("guard_units.csv",new String[][]{{"kind","units"},{"inferred",Arrays.toString(inferredGuardUnits)},{"explicit",Arrays.toString(actual)}});
    }
    static void uSnapshot(Model m,String file) throws Exception {
        if(!Arrays.equals(TIMES,m.sol("sol1").getPVals()))throw new IllegalStateException("Stored times changed");
        try(BufferedWriter w=writer(file)){row(w,new String[]{"solnum","time_s","size","sha256"});
            for(int i=0;i<TIMES.length;i++){double[] u=m.sol("sol1").getU(i+1);if(u.length==0)throw new IllegalStateException("Empty stored U");row(w,new String[]{Integer.toString(i+1),Double.toString(TIMES[i]),Integer.toString(u.length),vectorDigest(u)});}}
        event("file_closed",file);
    }
    static void writeMap(String file,TreeMap<String,String> map) throws Exception {
        try(BufferedWriter w=writer(file)){row(w,new String[]{"key","value"});for(Map.Entry<String,String> e:map.entrySet())row(w,new String[]{e.getKey(),e.getValue()});}
    }
    static void props(PropFeature f,String path,TreeMap<String,String> map) {
        map.put(path+"/@type",f.getType()); map.put(path+"/@active",Boolean.toString(f.isActive()));
        for(String p:f.properties())map.put(path+"/"+p,f.getValueType(p)+"|"+Arrays.deepToString(new Object[]{readSetting(f,p)}));
        if(f.hasSelection()){map.put(path+"/@selection_dim",Integer.toString(f.selection().dim()));map.put(path+"/@selection",Arrays.toString(f.selection().entities()));}
    }
    static void solverProps(SolverFeature f,String path,TreeMap<String,String> p){props(f,path,p);for(String t:f.feature().tags())solverProps(f.feature(t),path+"/"+t,p);}
    static void datasetProps(DatasetFeature f,String path,TreeMap<String,String> p){props(f,path,p);for(String t:f.feature().tags())datasetProps(f.feature(t),path+"/"+t,p);}
    static void plotProps(ResultFeature f,String path,TreeMap<String,String> p){props(f,path,p);for(String t:f.feature().tags())plotProps(f.feature(t),path+"/"+t,p);}
    static void children(PropFeatureList<PropFeature> list,String path,TreeMap<String,String> p){for(String t:list.tags())props(list.get(t),path+"/"+t,p);}
    static TreeMap<String,String> snapshot(Model m) throws Exception {
        TreeMap<String,String> p=new TreeMap<String,String>();
        for(String t:m.sol("sol1").feature().tags())solverProps(m.sol("sol1").feature(t),"sol1/"+t,p);
        p.put("binding/solution",m.result().dataset("daudit").getString("solution"));
        p.put("binding/mesh",m.sol("sol1").getMesh("geom1"));p.put("binding/components",Arrays.toString(m.component().tags()));
        p.put("binding/meshes",Arrays.toString(m.component("comp1").mesh().tags()));
        p.put("mesh/edge_entities",Arrays.toString(m.component("comp1").mesh("mesh1").getElemEntity("edg")));
        p.put("mesh/edge_count",Integer.toString(m.component("comp1").mesh("mesh1").getNumElem("edg")));
        for(String k:m.param().varnames())p.put("parameter/"+k,m.param().get(k));
        for(String t:new String[]{"minguardall","minguard1","minguard2","minguard3","minsurf1","maxsurf1","minsurf3","maxsurf3","intd1","intd2","intd3"})props(m.component("comp1").cpl(t),"coupling/"+t,p);
        for(String mat:new String[]{"mat35","mat54"})for(String fn:("mat35".equals(mat)?new String[]{"int3","int4"}:new String[]{"int1","int2"})) {
            props(m.component("comp1").material(mat).propertyGroup("def").func(fn),"ocp/"+mat+"/"+fn,p);
            if(!"none".equals(m.component("comp1").material(mat).propertyGroup("def").func(fn).getString("extrap")))throw new IllegalStateException("OCP extrapolation");}
        for(String t:m.result().dataset().tags())datasetProps(m.result().dataset(t),"dataset/"+t,p);
        for(String t:m.result().tags())plotProps(m.result(t),"plot/"+t,p);
        Set<String> observed=new TreeSet<String>(Arrays.asList(m.result().numerical().tags()));observed.removeAll(newTags);
        if(!observed.equals(originalNumerical))throw new IllegalStateException("Existing numerical tags changed");
        for(String t:observed){props(m.result().numerical(t),"numerical/"+t,p);children(m.result().numerical(t).feature(),"numerical/"+t,p);}
        for(String t:m.result().table().tags()){props(m.result().table(t),"table/"+t,p);children(m.result().table(t).feature(),"table/"+t,p);}
        for(String t:m.result().export().tags())props(m.result().export(t),"export/"+t,p);
        // These are declared readbacks, not a claim to capture every hidden result cache/UI field.
        return p;
    }
    static Object readSetting(com.comsol.model.PropFeature f,String p) {
        switch(f.getValueType(p)) {
            case "Boolean": return f.getBoolean(p);
            case "BooleanArray": return f.getBooleanArray(p);
            case "BooleanMatrix": return f.getBooleanMatrix(p);
            case "String": return f.getString(p);
            case "StringArray": return f.getStringArray(p);
            case "StringMatrix": return f.getStringMatrix(p);
            case "Int": return f.getInt(p);
            case "IntArray": return f.getIntArray(p);
            case "IntMatrix": return f.getIntMatrix(p);
            case "Double": return f.getDouble(p);
            case "DoubleArray": return f.getDoubleArray(p);
            case "DoubleMatrix": case "DoubleRowMatrix": return f.getDoubleMatrix(p);
            default: throw new IllegalArgumentException(f.getValueType(p));
        }
    }


    static void runtimeSettings(Model m,String sol,String time) throws Exception {
        // Read back actual settings from the stored solution. No settings changed here.
        String[][] settings={
            {"key","actual_value"},
            {"solution_tag",sol},{"time_tag",time},
            {"study_tlist",m.study("std1").feature("time").getString("tlist")},
            {"geometry_length_unit",m.component("comp1").geom("geom1").lengthUnit()},
            {"geometry_dimension",Integer.toString(m.component("comp1").geom("geom1").getSDim())},
            {"rtol",Double.toString(m.sol(sol).feature(time).getDouble("rtol"))},
            {"initialstepbdf",Double.toString(m.sol(sol).feature(time).getDouble("initialstepbdf"))},
            {"initialstepbdfactive",m.sol(sol).feature(time).getString("initialstepbdfactive")},
            {"maxstepconstraintbdf",m.sol(sol).feature(time).getString("maxstepconstraintbdf")},
            {"maxstepexpressionbdf",m.sol(sol).feature(time).getString("maxstepexpressionbdf")},
            {"maxstepbdf",Double.toString(m.sol(sol).feature(time).getDouble("maxstepbdf"))},
            {"tstepsbdf",m.sol(sol).feature(time).getString("tstepsbdf")},
            {"tout",m.sol(sol).feature(time).getString("tout")},
            {"consistent",m.sol(sol).feature(time).getString("consistent")},
            {"atolglobalmethod",m.sol(sol).feature(time).getString("atolglobalmethod")},
            {"atolglobalvaluemethod",m.sol(sol).feature(time).getString("atolglobalvaluemethod")},
            {"atolglobalfactor",Double.toString(m.sol(sol).feature(time).getDouble("atolglobalfactor"))},
            {"atolglobal",Double.toString(m.sol(sol).feature(time).getDouble("atolglobal"))},
            {"eventtol",Double.toString(m.sol(sol).feature(time).getDouble("eventtol"))},
            {"electrolyte_positive_check","SOLVER_MINIMUM_GUARD_PLUS_POSTPROCESSING; step-end sampled only"},
            {"profile_time_interpolation","off; all stored solnum; no t property set"},
            {"profile_spatial_evaluation","domain-selected FE Interp; recover off; ext 0; 241 common coordinates"}
        };
        table("axes_runtime_settings.csv",settings);
        for(int d=1;d<=3;d++) System.out.println("AXES_PHYSICAL_MESH_DOMAIN="+d+"|numelem="+m.component("comp1").mesh("mesh1").feature("edg1").feature("dis"+d).getString("numelem"));
        for(String pce:new String[]{"pce1","pce2"}) {
            PhysicsFeature pin=m.component("comp1").physics("liion").feature(pce).feature("pin1");
            System.out.println("AXES_PARTICLE="+pce+"|Nel="+pin.getString("Nel")+"|Nord="+pin.getString("Nord")+"|Distribution="+pin.getString("Distribution"));
        }
    }


    static void spatialProfiles(Model m) throws Exception {
        for(String mesh:m.component("comp1").mesh().tags()) {
            System.out.println("AXES_ACTUAL_MESH="+mesh+"|edges="+m.component("comp1").mesh(mesh).getNumElem("edg")+"|vertices="+m.component("comp1").mesh(mesh).getNumVertex());
            System.out.println("AXES_MESH_ELEMENT_DOMAINS="+mesh+"|"+Arrays.toString(m.component("comp1").mesh(mesh).getElemEntity("edg")));
        }
        double ln=m.param().evaluate("L_el"),ls=m.param().evaluate("L_sep"),lp=m.param().evaluate("L_pos");
        double[][] times=evaluate(m,"profiletimes","EvalGlobal",new String[]{"t"},new String[]{"s"},null);
        for(int domain:new int[]{1,3}) {
            String electrode=domain==1?"N":"P",tag="profile"+electrode;
            tag=PREFIX+tag;
            double[] coordinates=domain==1?COORD_N:COORD_P;
            ensureNew(m,tag);
            m.result().numerical().create(tag,"Interp");
            m.result().numerical(tag).set("data","daudit");
            m.result().numerical(tag).selection().geom("geom1",1);
            m.result().numerical(tag).selection().set(new int[]{domain});
            m.result().numerical(tag).set("coord",new double[][]{coordinates});
            m.result().numerical(tag).set("ext",0.0);
            m.result().numerical(tag).set("recover","off");
            m.result().numerical(tag).set("timeinterp","off");
            m.result().numerical(tag).set("coorderr","on");
            m.result().numerical(tag).set("expr",new String[]{"t","x","liion.socloc_surface","liion.cs_average/liion.csmax","liion.Eeq_per1","liion.etamid_per1","phil","dom"});
            m.result().numerical(tag).set("unit",new String[]{"s","m","1","1","V","V","V","1"});
            System.out.println("AXES_PROFILE_UNIT="+electrode+"|"+m.result().numerical(tag).getValueType("unit")+"|"+Arrays.toString(m.result().numerical(tag).getStringArray("unit")));
            m.result().numerical(tag).set("innerinput","all");
            validateInterp(m,tag,coordinates,domain);
            validateNumerical(m,tag,true);
            dumpNew(m,tag);
            event("evaluate",tag);
            double[][][] data=m.result().numerical(tag).getData();
            validateNumerical(m,tag,true);
            if(data.length!=8 || data[0].length!=times[0].length) throw new IllegalStateException("Profile expression/time shape mismatch "+electrode);
            try(BufferedWriter pw=writer("axes_profile_"+electrode+".csv")) {
            row(pw,new String[]{"time_s","coordinate_m","x_surface","x_particle_average","Eeq_V","etaMid_V","phil_V","domain_id"});
            for(int ti=0;ti<times[0].length;ti++) {
                for(int e=0;e<8;e++) if(data[e][ti].length!=coordinates.length) throw new IllegalStateException("Profile coordinate shape mismatch "+electrode);
                for(int j=0;j<coordinates.length;j++) {
                    if(data[0][ti][j]!=TIMES[ti]) throw new IllegalStateException("Profile time mismatch "+electrode);
                    if(Math.abs(data[1][ti][j]-coordinates[j])>1e-15 || Math.abs(data[7][ti][j]-domain)>1e-9) throw new IllegalStateException("Profile coordinate/domain mismatch "+electrode);
                    String[] cells=new String[8];
                    for(int e=0;e<8;e++) {
                        if(!Double.isFinite(data[e][ti][j])) throw new IllegalStateException("Nonfinite profile "+electrode+" expression "+e+" time "+ti+" point "+j);
                        cells[e]=Double.toString(data[e][ti][j]);
                    }
                    row(pw,cells);
                }
            }
            }
            System.out.println("AXES_PROFILE="+electrode+"|time_count="+times[0].length+"|coordinate_count="+coordinates.length+"|timeinterp=off|FE_spatial_interp=true|domain="+domain);
        }
    }


    static void audit(PhysicsFeature f, String name) throws Exception {
        table(name+"_selection.csv",new String[][]{{"key","value"},{"entities",Arrays.toString(f.selection().entities())}});
        for (String kind : new String[]{"Expression","Weak","Constraint"})
            table("equations_"+name+"_"+kind+".csv", f.featureInfo("info").getInfoTable(kind));
    }

}
